sub_indicators.label: The price of mobile data against income
sub_indicators.subject: infra.connect
sub_indicators.text: Mobile affordability: the price of mobile data against income
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Digital Transformation Strategy asks that access cost no more than one US cent a megabyte by 2030. The Broadband Commission's target, carried by the International Telecommunication Union, is entry-level broadband under 2 per cent of monthly income per person.
criteria: The newest figure, for 2024 or later, puts 5 GB of mobile data for a month above 10 per cent of average monthly income.

5 GB of mobile data for a month costs 10 per cent of average monthly income or less, on the newest figure for 2024 or later. Any dated, documented figure counts: a stated share of income, or a stated price set against World Bank income per person.
It costs 5 per cent or less.
It costs 2 per cent or less, the international target.
It costs 1 per cent or less. Promotional, daily and weekly bundles, plans sold with voice, and price floors are never used at any stage.
